sample_correlation

Source: R/fct_viz.R
sample_correlation.Rd

Correlation matrix between samples, computed on log2(counts + 1). Shared by the static and interactive correlation heatmaps.

Expects counts, raw or normalised, never already transformed : the log is applied here. Note that it only affects pearson : spearman and kendall work on ranks, which a monotonic transform leaves untouched.

sample_correlation(
  data,
  conds = unique(stringr::str_split_fixed(colnames(data), "_", 2)[, 1]),
  correlation_method = "pearson"
)

Arguments

data

a matrix of counts, samples as columns. At least two samples and three genes, no negative value.

conds

conditions to keep. Default : all of them. Conditions that are not in the data are ignored, with a warning.

correlation_method

correlation method for the cor function. Can be pearson, kendall or spearman.

Value

a square, unrounded correlation matrix

Examples

data("abiotic_stresses")
sample_correlation(abiotic_stresses$raw_counts)
